chunks: That the best thing with which it is cooked is water and salt.

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; a report transmitted without a cited sanad/isnad here
key_terms.مَاءٌ: water; the primary cooking ingredient mentioned

ai.seo_question: What is the best way to cook the 'aqiqah meat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the best manner of cooking the 'aqiqah meat is simply with water and salt. It indicates a plain and uncomplicated preparation in the context of the newborn-related sunnah (prophetic tradition) of 'aqiqah.
